ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Código de Comercio (arts. 98, 110-115 and 119-126); Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedades por Acciones Simplificadas, S.A.S.); Decreto Único Reglamentario 1074 de 2015 (RUES and Chamber of Commerce registration); Ley 526 de 1999 as amended (UIAF and AML/CFT institutional framework); Ley 1453 de 2011 and Decree 1674 de 2016 (PEP classification and sanctions); Estatuto Tributario art. 631-5 as introduced by Ley 2010 de 2019; Decreto 830 de 2021 and DIAN implementing resolutions on the Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales; Superintendencia de Sociedades administrative circulars. The pre-incorporation AML/CFT standard incorporates UIAF SARLAFT principles for non-regulated commercial entities.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of each shareholder, director and UBO against: OFAC SDN List and consolidated US sanctions; UN Security Council Consolidated List; EU and UK asset-freeze lists; Colombian UIAF PEP lists; Colombian domestic counter-terrorism lists under Ley 1453 de 2011 and Decree 1674 de 2016. Enhanced customer due diligence is required for any UBO holding 10% or more and for any PEP; source-of-funds and negative-news checks must be documented. Screening records must be retained for at least five years after the termination of the corporate relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RUES – Registro Único Empresarial y Social (https://www.rues.org.co) and the online name reservation module of the applicable Cámara de Comercio
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be in Spanish or in a Spanish transliteration using Latin-script characters. Foreign words are accepted only if they are commonly recognized technical terms, registered trademarks, or proper names that can be transliterated into Spanish. The denominación must include the token 'S.A.S.' and must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing Colombian company, commercial establishment, or protected trademark.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Any name identical or confusingly similar to an existing Colombian registered company or commercial establishment
Colombia, Nacional, Internacional, Presidencia, Ministerio, Superintendencia, Gobernación, Alcaldía, Registraduría, Procuraduría
Banco, Financiera, Aseguradora, Seguros, Reaseguradora, Cooperativa, Mutual, Bolsa, Valores, Fondo, Pensiones, Cesantías
Clínica, Hospital, Laboratorio, Petrolera, Minera, Exploración, Explotación, Petroquímica
Cruz Roja, ONU, Naciones Unidas, OEA
Terms that falsely imply official authorization, public utility status, or an activity requiring a regulated license
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation remains valid for 30 continuous days and is not automatically extended. If the S.A.S. incorporation is not completed within that period, a new reservation application must be filed. Upon rejection, the applicant may request a written explanation from the Cámara de Comercio and file an administrative reconsideration petition (recurso de reposición) before the same registry within 10 business days of notification. If denied, the applicant may file an appeal (recurso de apelación) to the Superintendencia de Sociedades within 10 business days. The appeal must include a comparative table of registered names, written consent of the registered owner or the relevant regulator's prior authorization for sensitive tokens, and evidence that the proposed name is not misleading.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible for the registered seat itself. The S.A.S. must maintain a domicilio social in a Colombian municipality with a precise physical address for service of judicial, administrative and Chamber of Commerce notices. A serviced office or registered-agent address is acceptable only if it is a real, staffed location available during business hours. A PO Box or online-only virtual office is not sufficient. For this fertilizer wholesale operation, a leased commercial office or warehouse address is necessary for commercial substance and inspection purposes.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 25% probability of an unannounced physical inspection in the first operating year. The likelihood is elevated because the business is classified as Medium_Risk_Enhanced for AML/CFT in the wholesale fertilizer sector, and Colombian authorities may verify registered office, commercial establishment, inventory and import/export documentation without prior notice.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada, arts. 1-5, 11-19); Código de Comercio, Decreto-Ley 410 de 1971 (arts. 110-354 on merchant registration and company law); Decreto Único Reglamentario 1074 de 2015 (arts. 2.2.2.37.1 et seq. on Registro Único Empresarial - RUES).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the jurisdiction of the registered office, acting through the Registro Mercantil / Registro Único Empresarial (RUES) platform.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation instrument) valid for S.A.S. without real property contributions; public deed (Escritura Pública) required if real estate is contributed.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital; incorporators freely fix capital, payable in installments up to two years, in cash or in kind; no escrow or deposit account is legally required, but paid-in capital must be declared in the RUES form and reflected in the shareholders' ledger.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [COMPANY NAME] S.A.S. - RESOLUTION NO. 1. WHEREAS the shareholders have agreed to incorporate a Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada under Law 1258 of 2008. NOW THEREFORE, RESOLVED: 1. The share subscription statements and paid-in capital declarations are ratified and registered in the shareholders' ledger. 2. The registered office is adopted at [address], [city], [department], Colombia. 3. [Name] is appointed Legal Representative with broad powers of representation and contract execution. 4. [Name] is appointed Secretary; the Revisor Fiscal shall be elected when statutory thresholds are met. 5. Management is authorized to file the RUT/NIT, open bank accounts, register the company, obtain licenses, and execute all ancillary acts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate name reservation and homonym clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered office jurisdiction via the RUES online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit up to three proposed corporate names using the 'consulta de homonimia' module. Reserve the accepted name, which remains valid for 30 calendar days, and verify that no identical or confusingly similar commercial name is already registered.
required_dossiers: Proposed company names with the 'S.A.S.' suffix
Draft corporate purpose description (ISIC 4669 / wholesale of fertilizers)
Identity document of the incorporator(s) or authorized filing agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If homonymy or similarity is found, submit a new name adding a distinctive element, geographic reference, or fanciful word, and re-run the consultation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-assignment of NIT and provisional RUT
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) through the Cámara de Comercio's integrated double-window service (Ventanilla Única Empresarial)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Enter the draft incorporation data and the legal representative's information in the pre-RUT system to obtain a provisional NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria). This NIT is used to open bank accounts and to file the final incorporation instrument.
required_dossiers: Draft incorporation document
Identity and address of the legal representative
Proposed registered office address
Email and contact details for DIAN notifications
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects the pre-RUT application due to discrepancies, correct the legal representative's personal data or corporate activity description and resubmit through the same portal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and legalization of the S.A.S. incorporation instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary (for signature acknowledgment) or Cámara de Comercio (if using digital signatures / legalization service)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the final Documento Privado de Constitución including bylaws: corporate name, purpose, term, capital, board structure, legal representation powers, and liquidation rules. Have all shareholders sign, acknowledge their signatures (auténticación) or use a certified digital signature, and keep the instrument ready for registry filing.
required_dossiers: Bylaws of the S.A.S.
Shareholder identification documents
Subscription and payment statements for each share
Appraisal report for in-kind contributions, if any
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a notary or chamber objects to a bylaw provision, amend the relevant clause by a corrective document signed by all shareholders and re-certify signatures.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Merchant registration and issuance of existence certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio / Registro Único Empresarial (RUES)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed incorporation instrument with the Formulario de Registro Único Empresarial (RUES), pay the registration tariff (derechos de inscripción plus SARLAFT fee), and obtain the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal. This registration automatically creates the definitive RUT in DIAN's records.
required_dossiers: Executed Documento Privado de Constitución
Completed RUES registration form
Certificate of approved company name
Provisional NIT / pre-RUT
Identification of the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry annotates formal defects, cure them by submitting a sworn correction letter together with supporting resolutions and re-file within the chamber's corrective period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Definitive RUT update and electronic invoicing enablement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN; approved electronic invoicing software providers
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Update the definitive RUT to reflect the principal and secondary ISIC codes (4669 wholesale of fertilizers) and the registered office. File the electronic invoicing registration (facturación electrónica) and obtain the activation of the electronic invoicing system with a certified software provider.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
NIT certificate
Legal representative identification
Corporate bank account details (for tax refund routing)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN queries the activity codes, provide a written explanation of the planned wholesale operations and supporting supply contracts, then request a revised RUT certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign trade enablement and ICA fertilizer registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN - VUPE (Ventanilla Única de Comercio Exterior); Instituto Colombiano Agropecuario (ICA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Enroll the company as importer/exporter in the Registro de Importadores y Exportadores through VUPE using the digital certificate. Prepare the fertilizer product registration file before the ICA (Resolución ICA 000150 de 2003) covering product label, nutrient composition, and origin documentation for prilled urea and potassium chloride.
required_dossiers: Definitive RUT and NIT certificate
Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Official product label and technical data sheet
Certificate of free sale from country of origin (for imported fertilizers)
Laboratory analysis certifying NPK / nutrient content
Commercial proforma invoices or supply agreements
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If ICA requires additional composition or agronomic studies, submit the supplemental laboratory certificate or amend the label text; the application will be reactivated once the technical dossier is complete.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Instituto Colombiano Agropecuario (ICA) - Subgerencia de Insumos Agrícolas, División de Fertilizantes
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registro de Fertilizantes y Acondicionadores de Suelo (for each prilled urea and potassium chloride product) plus municipal warehouse operating registration (Registro de Bodega / Uso de Suelo)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) and the competent regional Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 - Environmental registration and minor permits (discharge permit and solid waste management plan); full EIA only triggered by large-scale storage or granulation facilities above environmental license thresholds.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Resolución 0631 de 2015 for non-domestic wastewater: pH 6.0 - 9.0, total suspended solids ≤ 50 mg/L, BOD5 ≤ 70 mg/L; particulate matter and dust controls per Resolución 2254 de 2017 (PM10 ≤ 50 µg/m³ annual average, PM2.5 ≤ 25 µg/m³); fertilizer packaging waste managed under Resolución 1407 de 2018; no significant VOC threshold applies to non-reactive urea/potash storage.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Certificado de Bomberos (fire safety certificate) for the warehouse and handling areas; structural load inspection and land-use endorsement issued by the municipal Curaduría Urbana or planning authority; occupational health and safety program (SST) registered with the ARL under Ley 1562 de 2012; if ammonium nitrate is later added to the product mix, additional clearance from the Superintendencia de Vigilancia y Seguridad Privada will be mandatory.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — National Tax and Customs Authority of Colombia; electronic taxpayer services via DIAN Virtual/MUISCA portal (muisca.dian.gov.co); institutional portal: www.dian.gov.co.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The S.A.S. is first incorporated through the Cámara de Comercio/RUES; the legal representative then files the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) with DIAN to obtain the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria), the sole statutory tax ID, and to activate tax responsibilities (income tax; IVA as responsable del régimen común; electronic invoicing; customs/exporter registration for goods exit). Non-resident shareholders must appoint a locally domiciled tax attorney-in-fact; RUT filing and all subsequent obligations require the DIAN digital certificate (firma electrónica).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or pass-through election exists; classification is statutory under the Commercial Code and Estatuto Tributario. Available statutory mechanisms: (i) optional Régimen SIMPLE de Tributación (ET Arts. 903–916) for entities below the annual UVT gross-income ceiling, consolidating income tax, VAT and municipal tax — the election must be weighed against export VAT-refund positioning; (ii) mandatory CFC/transparencia fiscal internacional pass-through attribution (ET Arts. 881–889, Law 1819/2016) for controlled non-resident entities (not an election); (iii) transfer-pricing documentation elections and advance pricing agreements under ET Arts. 260-1 et seq.; hybrid mismatch deductions are restricted.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No monetary exemption threshold for legal entities: every S.A.S. performing taxable wholesale activities must register with DIAN as an IVA-responsable (régimen común) in the RUT from commencement of operations; the SIMPLE alternative is restricted to taxpayers under the statutory UVT-based gross-income ceiling (for legal entities, 100,000 UVT, approximately COP 4.7 billion for tax year 2024) and may not suit export-refund optimization.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time e-invoicing: the S.A.S. must issue factura electrónica de venta (FEV) through a DIAN-authorized provider or direct API; each invoice XML set is transmitted to DIAN's web-service validation before issuance and receives an aceptada/validada status (Resolución DIAN 000165/2023 technical specs); the client PDF must show the DIAN QR digital fiscal stamp. Electronic transporte/remission documents and the documento soporte for purchases from non-invoicing suppliers are also mandatory for goods flows.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of prilled urea and potassium chloride sold to non-residents and physically removed from Colombian customs territory qualify as ventas exentas (zero-rated) under ET Art. 481, removing output IVA while preserving the exporter's refund right over attributable input VAT (saldo a favor). The S.A.S. must hold RUT exporter registration, a definitive export declaration (DEX), transport evidence, and comply with FX repatriation and transfer-pricing substance. Note: domestic fertilizer sales may be VAT-excluded under the ET Art. 424 agro-input exclusion, without refund right, so input VAT segregation between domestic excluded sales and export volumes is critical.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación — DEX) validated by DIAN customs through the authorized customs broker; contains fiscal, tariff, statistical and value data for the urea/potash shipment
Bill of Lading (sea) or equivalent transport document (air waybill or CMR for land exports) evidencing physical removal of the goods from Colombian customs territory

Inward Remittance Certificate / foreign-exchange settlement evidence (certificado de negociación de divisas and declaración de cambio) issued by the authorized FX intermediary proving collection within the statutory repayment term
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN cross-audits export IVA refund claims (devolución de saldos a favor) against the DEX, bills of lading, export invoices and FX settlement records; any inconsistency triggers rejection, retrospective clawback and moratory interest. Sanctions: ET Art. 670 (devolución o compensación improcedente) fines up to 100% of the amount refunded; ET Art. 648 (inexactitud) penalties up to 200% (160% for periods under Law 2277/2022) of the tax difference; Law 1762/2015 customs contraband fines of 100%–300% of the customs value with confiscation; criminal exposure (customs/tax fraud) with imprisonment for executives; and suspension from exporter privileges upon repeat non-compliance.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Central Bank of Colombia), with the Ministry of Finance and Public Credit (Ministerio de Hacienda y Crédito Público) and the National Tax and Customs Directorate (DIAN) exercising complementary oversight; all foreign-exchange transactions must be channeled through authorized intermediaries of the foreign-exchange market (intermediarios del mercado cambiario, 'IMCs').
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia operates a managed-float currency regime with full current-account convertibility for trade in goods and services and regulated but open capital-account convertibility. Foreign direct investment (FDI) may enter and exit freely but must be registered with Banco de la República under the Registro de Inversión Internacional to secure lawful profit remittance and capital repatriation. Decree 2438 of 2020 and Resolution 5044 of 2020 as amended eliminated the historical 5-year minimum denationalization holding period and the USD 100,000 registration threshold, substantially removing administrative hurdles for foreign-owned SAS entities; dividend and capital remittances remain subject to Colombian withholding taxes but require no additional FX authorization once the investment is registered and the corresponding declaración de cambio is filed with the IMC.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Exporters of physical goods, including prilled urea and potassium chloride, must channel 100% of export proceeds into the Colombian FX market within 12 months counted from the date of collection (fecha de recaudo) of the proceeds. Channeling is satisfied by selling the foreign currency to an IMC in exchange for COP, or by depositing the funds into a registered foreign-currency compensation account (cuenta de compensación) held at a Colombian financial institution or a registered account abroad. No partial conversion ratio is applied to compensation-account balances, but the full offshore balance remains subject to the channeling obligation before any unreported disposal; non-compliance exposes the SAS to exchange-control fines by Banco de la República and triggers enhanced AML/KYC reassessment by its banking counterparts.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account
Operational Account and Trade Finance Settlement Account
Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Colombia has no dedicated EMI license category; non-bank digital payment providers operate as Sociedades Especializadas en Depósitos y Pagos Electrónicos (SEDPEs) supervised by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia and cannot issue documentary credits, trade loans, or FX intermediation. Offshore digital EMIs lack access to local COP clearing rails (SEN, CUD, ACH) and are functionally inadequate as primary treasury counterparties for high-value urea/potash wholesale transactions; they may serve only as auxiliary AP/AR settlement tools for sub-threshold incidental payments.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Colombian Tier-1 banks generally require the legal representative and at least one director or ultimate beneficial owner to attend an initial in-person compliance interview at a Colombian branch, or a bank-approved videoconference reinforced with biometric verification and apostilled corporate documents. Remote onboarding is legally permissible on a risk-based approach under Colombian AML Law 2155 of 2021 and Part 1 of Circular Básica Jurídica, but foreign-owned trading companies classified as medium-risk are customarily expected to complete at least one physical visit or a notarized electronic KYC interview. Full onboarding additionally requires apostilled certificate of incorporation, valid RUT, certificado de existencia y representación legal from the Cámara de Comercio, original board resolutions, and authenticated proof of identity for all signatories and beneficial owners.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque non-resident beneficial ownership chain, particularly a foreign parent routed through Panama or other high-surveillance jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Updated beneficial ownership register (Registro Final de Beneficiarios), apostilled constitutional documents of every entity in the chain, organizational chart identifying all individuals holding ≥5% equity, source-of-wealth and source-of-funds declarations, tax residence certificates from the country of incorporation, and a comfort letter from the parent's external auditor.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money-laundering red flags in agricultural commodity trading, including price volatility of urea/potash, third-country payments, and over- or under-invoicing risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete trade file per shipment: signed purchase contract, final commercial invoice, packing list, original bill of lading, certificate of origin, independent weight and quality certificates (e.g., SGS, Intertek), pre-shipment inspection report, SWIFT MT103/MT700 records, and a documented OECD-compliant transfer-pricing analysis evidencing arm's-length commodity prices.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid movement of funds between numerous sub-accounts and offshore counterparties inconsistent with a 60–120 day LC trade cycle.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Projected 12-month cash-flow forecast, aging report of receivables/payables, counterparty banking references from well-regulated institutions, audited financial statements or internally prepared financial pack if newly incorporated, and a written treasury policy confirming mandatory LC or documentary collection payment terms for all purchases.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Initial capital injection materialized at a premium or in-kind contribution exceeding the authorized capital of the SAS without bank visibility of the underlying corporate act.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized board and shareholders' minutes approving the capital increase, amended bylaws duly filed with the Cámara de Comercio, FDI registration certificate issued by Banco de la República, source-of-funds evidence (parent bank statements and loan agreements if shareholder financing is used), and a statutory auditor's statement confirming the contribution conforms to Colombian accounting framework.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Incoming shareholder equity contributions must be routed via SWIFT MT103 or MT202 to the SAS's account at an authorized IMC, referencing the company NIT and the foreign-exchange declaration form (Declaración de Cambio por Inversión Internacional). The IMC files the declaración under the direct investment category, and the SAS must register the investment with Banco de la República within 30 calendar days of receipt; remitter and beneficiary details must exactly match the FDI registration to ensure lawful profit repatriation. Disbursement in COP occurs at the representative market rate (TRM); no minimum capital verification is required for SAS formation.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements for prilled urea and potassium chloride must be executed through the IMC using SWIFT MT103 wire transfers or irrevocable documentary credits (SWIFT MT700) issued by the Colombian bank in favor of overseas suppliers. Each outbound payment requires a Declaración de Cambio de Importación (Formulario No. 1) with the import-of-goods purpose code '4202', filed at the time of payment, and must be reconciled against the DIAN import declaration and underlying invoice/packing documents. The recommended rail is an irrevocable confirmed LC at 60–120 days sight to mitigate supplier performance and jurisdictional risk in the agrochemical commodity chain.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable COP/USD forwards executed with authorized IMCs
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on COP/USD and COP/EUR
Cross-currency interest rate swaps (CCIRS) covered by real trade-finance exposure
Over-the-counter FX options and commodity price hedges (caps/floors) transacted under the Colombian Mercado de Derivados Estandarizados with licensed counterparties

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil (annual commercial registry renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered domicile (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March of each calendar year, covering the preceding legal year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal triggers the Chamber's surcharge tariff plus inability to issue official certificates; three consecutive years of non-renewal allow the Cámara de Comercio to cancel the registration and place the S.A.S. in administrative dissolution and winding-up without judicial process.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Asamblea General de Accionistas (annual shareholders' meeting and minute recordation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Internal governance act recorded in the statutory Minute Book; notarized extract filed with Chamber when required
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Must be held within the first three months after 31 December of the prior year, i.e., by 31 March (C. de Comercio Art. 183; Law 222/1995).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-holding leaves financial statements unapproved, blocks the timely deposit with the Chamber, and exposes the directors and legal representative to Superintendencia de Sociedades sanctions and civil liability for corporate losses.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Depósito de Estados Financieros (deposit of approved annual financial statements, including auditor's report when Revisor Fiscal is mandatory)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered domicile
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after approval by the shareholders' meeting, and no later than 30 April of the following year for a calendar-year S.A.S. (aligned with the 31 March approval deadline).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late deposit accrues Chamber surcharges, blocks issuance of the legal existence certificate, and is treated as an irregularity justifying administrative fines and loss of good-standing status for commercial and banking operations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración de Renta y Complementarios (annual corporate income tax return of the S.A.S.)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Second week of August of the year following the tax year, on the DIAN schedule determined by the last two digits of the NIT (e.g., FY 2024 return due in August 2025).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Extemporaneous filing fine under ET Art. 641 is 5% of the income tax payable for each month of delay, limited to 100% of the tax, with a minimum of 10 UVT (approx. USD 118); monthly default interest accrues until payment; chronic omission permits DIAN presumption of income and supports administrative strike-off when combined with registry cancellation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Información Exógena (annual exogenous third-party information return covering suppliers, clients, equity, withholding, IVA, ICA and foreign trade data)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (electronic filing via the transaction platform)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within the calendar window published by DIAN, currently between 15 February and 30 April of the year following the tax year, sometimes extended by NIT segment.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Per ET Art. 651: omission fine of 1% of the total unreported values, capped at 15,000 UVT (approx. USD 177,000); inexact or untimely filing carries fines up to 10,000 UVT (approx. USD 118,000); non-compliance additionally freezes tax refund proceedings and foreign trade authorizations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Actualización de Beneficiario Final (annual UBO confirmation of direct and indirect beneficial owners)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio / Superintendencia de Sociedades through the Registro de Beneficiario Final module (OASIS/SIBR platform)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within the decree-specified window, currently the first semester of each year (recent cycles: 1 February through 30 June / 31 July); any qualifying change of control or 5%-or-greater shareholding during the year must be updated within one month of the event.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Superintendencia de Sociedades may fine both the entity and the legal representative; the Chamber will refuse to issue commercial registry certificates or process the annual renewal until the UBO filing is regularized, and notarial, banking and import procedures are consequently blocked.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración Anual del Impuesto de Industria y Comercio (ICA), with complementary Avisos y Tableros (municipal gross-receipts tax on wholesale trading)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Municipal treasury of each municipality of operation (e.g., Secretaría Distrital de Hacienda de Bogotá D.C.); Colombia applies a unitary national system without subnational income taxes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 30 April of the year following the tax year in most municipalities; certain large taxpayers must also remit monthly or bimonthly advance installments during the year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Municipal surcharges and interest apply at roughly 2% per month of delay, capped at 100% of the ICA due; the taxpayer is flagged in the municipal registry, official certificates are suspended, and clients' withholding certificates cannot be generated until full settlement.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Revisor Fiscal is mandatory when at the prior 31 December the S.A.S. has gross assets or gross ordinary income exceeding 5,000 SMMLV (approx. COP 7.12 billion in 2025), when it has more than five shareholders, or when it is listed, a public-utility operator, or subject to permanent State supervision (C. de Comercio Art. 203; Law 43/1990). Below these thresholds, an independent certified public accountant review is sufficient.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS-embedded Colombian framework under Decree 2420/2015 (as amended). A typical wholesale fertilizer S.A.S. falls in Grupo 2 and applies NIIF para las PYMES (IFRS for SMEs); Grupo 1 full IFRS applies once public-interest thresholds are exceeded. Financial statements are expressed in COP and must be approved by the annual shareholders' meeting.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The S.A.S. must maintain an annotated Shareholder Registry Book; every transfer, pledge or endorsement of shares is effective against the company only upon annotation. Annually, the company must disclose all direct and indirect beneficial owners with 5% or more of capital, voting or control rights through the Chamber of Commerce Beneficiario Final module, within the published window, and must update the registry within one month after any mid-year qualifying change. The UBO filing is a prerequisite for the commercial registry renewal.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Acciones) - sequential annotation of share transfers, endorsements and pledges (C. de Comercio Art. 397)
Minute Book (Libro de Actas de Asamblea General y Juntas Directivas) - consecutively numbered, dated and signed
Accounting records (Libro Diario, Libro Mayor, Inventarios and supporting vouchers) - kept in the registered office and preserved per C. de Comercio Art. 67
Shareholder attendance list and proxy archive annexed to the Minute Book

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: 800 - 2,200 (registered commercial domicile, legal representation and corporate-administrative support to the Chamber renewal)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 4,500 - 12,000 if the Revisor Fiscal threshold of 5,000 SMMLV is exceeded; 800 - 1,500 for a Contador Público external review below the threshold
